column1: # Coding runtimes are the agent executables the coding lane may run, pinned
# the way scripts/models.tsv pins checkpoints: one row per release, verified
# against the publisher's own digest artifact before extraction, installed
# into a versioned directory, and reached through a candidate symlink the
# fetcher updates atomically so the prior version stays available.
# execution_policy states whether the runtime may execute at all, over
# `refused` and `validator-gated`. Every checked-in row reads `refused`: the
# coding lane executes nothing until the model-depth, switch-policy,
# containment, and full-chain admission gates pass, and moving a row is a
# reviewed edit rather than a runtime decision. asset_sha256 is the digest
# the publisher's SHA256SUMS release artifact states for asset_name, so a
# fetched archive is verified against the publisher rather than against this
# repository alone. install_directory and executable are relative to the
# install root the fetcher takes as its argument.
